disjoint_from.note: source works (OpenAlex IDs) are disjoint from the original 100 items

labels.support: claim = a core abstract sentence; evidence contains it
labels.partial: evidence is only the first assertion clause
labels.contradict: one assertion flipped to its antonym
labels.no_evidence: evidence is an unrelated paper with low title/fragment similarity

note: constructed probes; labels are a property of the construction, not model output
